overview.description: The Founder-Led ETF (FDRS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Founder Led index. The fund is passively managed to track an index of the top 50 largest, publicly traded US companies where at least one original founder serves in the C-suite or equivalent role. Companies are weighted by market-cap in the underlying portfolio. FDRS was launched on Dec 29, 2025 and is issued by Corgi.
